title: Report a missing resource
summary: Spring Boot: Report a missing resource. Inspect the status with curl -i.
introduction: ResponseEntity lets code choose a status and body. Open GET /missing.
learningObjectives: Report a missing resource with Spring Boot

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Report a missing resource

blocks.text: ResponseEntity carries both 404 and the error object to the response writer.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A failure should not use a success status just because it has a body.

seo.description: Spring Boot: Report a missing resource. Inspect the status with curl -i. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
